profile.headline: Distributed systems and full stack engineer with 18 years of experience designing, scaling and operating cloud services. I love digging into hard problems and helping my teammates grow.
profile.summary:
* Distributed systems and Full Stack Developer
* Experienced with building complex systems from the ground up and improving existing ones
* Experienced maintaining high load systems
* Experienced working remotely.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Red Canary was acquired by ZScaler.

Working on the Red Canary Platform team

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as Technical Lead on Platform team. Working on a large range of problems on both a large Rails monolith owned by that team and various microservices that support it.

Lots of experience here doing all sorts of things working on scaling, observability, reliability and mentoring. And how to help my team and the other teams that worked on the platform work quickly while keeping the system reliable.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Acted as product owner and technical lead for tools supporting finance, operations and manufacturing across 13 facilities
Worked directly with CFO and subject matter experts designing and delivering software solutions to fix accounting and observability issues

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead technical migration from a legacy ERP system using the strangler fig pattern. Modernizing critical business workflows with near zero downtime.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with two other developers building out an ecommerce platform specialized for shipping perishable foods from restaurants across the country.
* Rebuilt checkout application using Ember.js. Designing it’s backend connection as a public API for future applications and 3rd parties to hook into.
* Wrote a shipping calendar system that takes a large number of dynamic conditions into account to calculate out delivery days so customers can easily choose between all available viable delivery days for the specific product they are ordering.
* Worked closely with the product manager to implement features needed to achieve business goals.
Used Responsive Web Design to deliver the same HTML to mobile and desktop users with appropriate display for the device being used
* Maintained and technically supported production application running on Heroku.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
A startup that pioneered microinverters for converting photovoltaic solar panel power from DC to AC. I work on their Enlighten product which takes in information for each solar panel and makes it available for solar installers, consumers and other partners. Enlighten has over 40,000 sites reporting in energy data every 5 minutes.

* Wrote a replacement for a Flash power visualizer (called Array Viewer) in JavaScript using HTML5’s Canvas 2d Context. Had to handle power animation of up to 2,000 solar panels at once using 5 minute interval data. Also implemented panning, zooming, and an overhead view. (screenshot)
* Worked on a team with 4 other software engineers on the Enlighten web application.
* Upgraded Enlighten (with over 25k LOC) from Rails 2.3 to Rails 3.0. 
* Used Test Driven Development with RSpec and Rails 
* Assisted on the company’s first iOS application that makes it easier for solar installers to
map their solar systems.

positions.title: Web Application Consultant
positions.description:
* Built a specialized SaaS Wedding CMS called Wedding Jojo (http://www.weddingjojo.com/) and maintained it for 2 years. Hosted on Heroku, using S3 for filestorage, Postgres as a relational database, HAML, SASS 
* Wrote a theme customizer for Wedding Jojo using JavaScript to change CSS properties
and images for a live preview 
* Wrote a direct to S3 File Uploader for Wedding Jojo using HTML5’s FileAPI. It uses no flash, has a progress bar and gets around Heroku’s timeouts by uploading directly to S3. 
* Built a social sharing site targeted at woman called Is That Odd (http://isthatodd.com/). Used HTML and CSS techniques to create a graphical heavy interface that would traditionally been created using Flash. Ran on Heroku using Postgres as the relational database and file storage with S3.

positions.title: Lead Web Developer (started as Web Developer)
positions.description:
* Lead a team of 3 maintaining Actionrev. 
* Managed Actionrev running on EC2. 
* Talked directly with clients about their problems and then designed solutions to meet their needs.

positions.title: Customer Service Manager
positions.description:
A startup that uses Amazon’s mTurk to transcribe audio files. I worked remotely for them handling their customer support requests.

* Wrote a JavaScript utility to clean up transcripts in programmatic way. 
* Worked with co-founders to help improve interfaces to help Amazon’s workers better
understand the tasks. 
* Wrote a special Flash audio player that could be set to automatically pause after so much time for workers without foot pedals to pause the audio. 
* I helped design some new tasks and instructions for their contractors on Amazon's Mechanical Turk. This included a lot of brainstorming and Customer UX thinking for how to help these workers do higher quality work.
